content.value: A rigid block of mass M is supported by three symmetrically spaced rods as shown, in Figure-2(a). Each copper rod has an area of 900 mm², E=120 GPa and the allowable stress is 70 MPa. The steel rod has an area of 1200 mm², E= 200 GPa and the allowable stress is 140 MPa. Determine the largest mass M which can be supported.
